title: Define Product Terminology Foundation
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the Work path, owner repository, Checklist target, or Evidence target before editing.
The terminology document would claim Core, Backend, Editor, compatibility, or product readiness as current without evidence.
A term remains ambiguous across Project Control, Core, Backend, or Editor and cannot be classified as define, split, rename, deprecated, context-only, or blocked.
The change would require editing product behavior in Core, Backend, or Editor.
Project Control checks cannot validate the new documents, records, generated index, or guidance contract.
verificationTarget: Project Control records product terminology documents, Work, Phase, Checklist, Evidence target, and FlowDoc guidance rules that future product/frontend rounds must read before resolving overloaded terms, while product repositories remain unchanged and FlowDoc truth remains planned.
summary: Done: Project Control now has a product terminology foundation and terminology discipline rule for future Editor/frontend and cross-repository product work without promoting product readiness.
